title: Report: Russia's nuclear-powered 'Skyfall' missile is dirty and dangerous
summary: MIT researchers think they've worked out exactly how Russia's Burevestnik nuclear-powered missile flies. "It's almost certainly a terrible idea," one analyst said. "But it's not an impossible idea."
contentText:
